name: Pumpkin Soup
steps: Peel and deseed the pumpkin, then cut it into 3-4 cm chunks. Roughly chop the onion and garlic.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for about 3 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the pumpkin and vegetable stock. Bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 25 minutes until the pumpkin is very tender.
Take the pot off the heat and let it cool for a few minutes, then blend until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir in most of the cream, season with salt and pepper, and reheat gently without letting it boil. Thin with a little water if it's too thick.
Ladle into bowls and finish each with a swirl of the remaining cream, snipped chives and a grind of black pepper.
